starter_questions: Can I try the synthetic household packet first?
Which records do you need for my review?
What needs my advisor’s attention, and what evidence is missing?

fields.label: Saved instructions
fields.description: Manage explicit preferences and working rules in Chat > Memory. Applies to future runs.

setup_guide.introduction: I'll review cash flow, tax paperwork and portfolio risks, with sources and questions for your advisor. Try the synthetic household sample, or choose your approved documents. You'll get a draft review; I don't file taxes or move money.

sample.title: Synthetic household review
sample.description: Review sample cash-flow records, tax paperwork and fixture-priced holdings. These are demonstration records, not your finances.
sample.expected_output: After the sample review completes, a draft household review with supporting records, missing or outdated data and questions for your advisor.

real.introduction: Choose the approved financial-document folder and output location. I’ll prepare a draft review with source periods, gaps and advisor questions; review customer goals and portfolio settings before interpreting it.

fields.label: Document folder
fields.description: Local folder monitored for personal finance, bank statement, tax, and portfolio documents.

fields.label: Output folder
fields.description: Local folder where JSON and Markdown advisor reports should be written.
